lines.en: My short legs move fast
I trot past the corridor
My balloon trails from my hand
I walk a little crooked
My plated feet tap the floor
I lean half out from a door
I walk along behind you
I glance back every few steps
My shadow is even shorter than me
I slip along the wall base
I shuffle quickly along
I cut around ahead of you
I sway with my head tilted
My eyes glow a fake glow
I look like I am smiling even now
I bob the balloon in my hand
My mouth stays open
One of my joints squeaks
I rock twice in place
I tip my head to my shoulder
I count the corridor lights
I hop once, small
My teeth are neither sharp nor dull
I look like I want someone to play
I let out a soft click
I turn my face to you
You are so much taller than me
I look up at you
Will you play with me
Look at my balloon
I smile and tip my head
Why are you not smiling at all
I raise both little hands
I take one small step forward
My eyes never close
Do not walk so fast
I reach a hand toward you
I smile and back half a step
Can you hear my steps
I measure how tall you are
I circle once at your feet
I tip right over
I shake and my parts rattle
My balloon has fallen
I am more fragile than you think
Just one, I remember it

lines.zh: 别打我，我只是在看着你。
lines.en: Don't hit me — I was only watching you.

lines.zh: 零件松了……你听见响声了吗？
lines.en: A part came loose... did you hear that?

lines.zh: 痛吗？我早就忘了痛是什么。
lines.en: Does it hurt? I forgot what pain was long ago.
I do not eat

lines.zh: 你把东西举高我也够不到
lines.en: Raise it all you like, I cannot reach
I am a toy, I have no stomach
Food is no fun at all
A balloon would be better
Can that thing be eaten
I reach and cannot touch it
I cannot smell anything
Put the food away
I prefer something shiny
My balloon flies out of my hand
I land sitting on the floor
I am light, one hit sends me back
My head tips the other way
You stepped on my foot
I catch the wall to steady myself
I hurry out of your way
I smile at you anyway
I pick the balloon up and stand
I am only a toy
What I want is a playmate
Nobody plays with me here
Can I play with you
I smile, but you do not
I do not understand this at all
I always stand here alone
Would you stay
I will give you my balloon
Are you leaving now
I pick up my balloon
I hug it to my chest
I cannot lift anything heavy
This one is shiny
I hold it up and wave it
I fumble and drop it
I lift it over my head
My fingers are too short
I keep it as a toy
You pushed me just now
My head turns fast
I take a step at you
I am going for your legs
I am not smiling now
My steps suddenly quicken
Run and I follow
Did you bump me again
I am short, but I am quick
I am going to bite you
You touched my balloon
I look up at your hand
This time I grab you
I step at your shadow
I stay right on your cuffs
Long legs will not shake me
I have dropped the balloon
I cut ahead to the doorway
You just stepped on my foot
I chase with my head tilted
My steps are all short
I wait for you to stop
I follow your boot prints
You are a little faster than me
I trot behind you
My hand is up
Two of your steps, one of mine, close enough
Turn, and I stick close
I wait in this corridor
You had better not look back
My little hands claw your leg
My teeth catch the cloth
I tug at your trouser cuff
I pound at you
My head butts your knee
I hang on your leg
I claw at your fingers
I headbutt your stomach
I yank your sleeve
I leap and cling to you
I bite your bootlace
I hit twice in a row
I dart about your legs
A small click comes from behind the door
I stand there holding a balloon
My eyes light first
I step out of the dark, head tilted

lines.zh: 走廊里多了一个矮影子
lines.en: A short shadow joins the corridor
The floor creaks under me
I smile without a sound
I edge out from behind the curtain
My hand still holds the balloon
I stand between the door and you
I crawl out of the vent
My balloon catches the light
My footsteps are very light
I stand in the corridor shadow
My head appears first
I smile and raise the balloon
I hop down from the stairwell
I pause in the doorway
Fire warps my faceplate
Half of me comes apart in the fall

lines.zh: 水从嘴里灌进去，我不动了
lines.en: Water pours in my mouth and I stop
The blast throws me at the wall
An arrow goes through my hand
Magic pops on my shell

lines.zh: 我本来就不用吃，只是锈了
lines.en: I never ate, I am only rusting
The strike throws sparks from me
I fall still waving
